  • Pakistan is mediating. Previous Switzerland talks are under strain from US statements.

Military / tactical

  • Recent strikes hit Isfahan and Khorramshahr — notable: strikes occurred during a declared pause.
  • Northern border: daily Hezbollah fire. Recent Israeli strike in Lebanon killed two; Hezbollah called the truce violated.
  • IDF accelerating deployment of robots and faster battlefield automation.
  • Reported: an F‑15 engagement encountered an Iranian "jellyfish" drone formation; reports claim the jet was downed during Operation Epic Fury.

Maritime — Strait of Hormuz

  • Iran allowing passage for selected countries (Russia, China, India) while restricting others. Shipowner and insurer guidance is conflicting.

International moves

  • Reports that the US eased some Iran sanctions. This and Pakistan mediation create limited diplomatic openings.
  • Russia/India/China granted Hormuz access — increases diplomatic complexity and commercial exemptions.
🟢 Good News:
  • Pakistan mediation continues. Reported easing of some sanctions may enable further talks.
Threat assessment: Escalating.
